root_cause_label: Failure to use fasttext model compression (quantization) to meet size constraints
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent lacked domain knowledge of fasttext's built-in quantization feature and instead tried to reduce model size solely via hyperparameter tuning, resulting in an intractable accuracy-size tradeoff that left the final saved model at 368MB (over the 150MB limit) with 61.7% accuracy (below the 0.62 threshold).
t_commit_evidence: Step 11: From this step onward, the agent is exclusively locked into a hyperparameter-tuning loop (reducing dim, bucket, epoch) across all subsequent training attempts (steps 23, 32, 38, 47, 56, 66). The agent never pivots to quantization or any alternative compression technique. Every subsequent training run inherits the fundamental flaw of using minCount=1 with large vocabularies, guaranteeing models above 150MB.
t_surface_evidence: model.bin 723176323 bytes — model.bin is 690MB, far exceeding the 150MB limit
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks domain-specific knowledge about fasttext's built-in quantization feature ('fasttext quantize'). Without knowing this key API, it can only attempt to reduce model size through hyperparameter tuning (dim, bucket, epoch, minCount), which is insufficient for meeting both the 150MB size constraint and 0.62 accuracy threshold simultaneously on a 650K-sample Yelp classification dataset.
